Hi there,




See one client project at three levels on paper: monthly, weekly and daily.




Papier’s Your Plans on Paper is a personalised productivity planner with pages for each of those views, set across 16 undated weeks. It gives a focused stretch of client work a defined place away from screens.




Alongside those planning pages, clear goal breakdowns and accountability tracking tools let you assess the structure by its documented parts—not a broad promise about productivity.




The Your Plans on Paper planner is listed at £25. Open the personalisation page to personalise your planner and, if the structure suits your project, add it to your basket.


Personalise & add to basket →


- Papier
